none: PAS CAM-FF0F68: Roman Coin : A base silver plated contemporary copy of a Denarius of Tiberius
contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A base silver plated contemporary copy of a Denarius of Tiberius. AD25-26 (Reece period 1). Reverse retrograde legend reads [...]MAXIM [...]. Reverse shows Female figure seated right, holding sceptre and branch. Copying a coin minted in Rome. See cf.RIC I, p.95, no.30. Obverse shows Laureate head right. Obverse retrograde legend reads [...] AVG F AVGVSTVS. Die axis is 12 o'clock, weight is 2.4g,…
